name: Dark Cinematic Car Reel
source: TikTok reel, 18.9s (15.9s edit + 3s TikTok end card)

intro.effect: letterbox squeeze: black bars close in from full frame to a thin ~2.35:1 strip on a wide establishing shot, hold, then open back to full 9:16 on the first cut

timeline.rhythm: cuts on the beat (~80 BPM, every 1 beat); one longer hold (10.7 -> 13.0) for the hero shot before the outro
timeline.micro_effects: short flicker/flash cuts around 8.4s and 9.2s (2-3 frame stutter)
timeline.outro: last shot fades to black at ~15.9s, audio ends with it

camera.style: handheld gimbal, slow push-ins and orbits
camera.angles: very low, dutch tilt 10-20 deg, macro details
camera.speed: slight slow motion feel (shoot 60fps, conform to 30)

color_grade.look: low-key dark matte, almost monochrome, red accents kept
steps: HSL: keep reds (sat +20), desaturate all other hues

audio.notes: one music track (deep/phonk style), heavily compressed; normalize to -14 LUFS, limit true peak to -1 dBTP

text_overlays: none (only TikTok watermark, added by platform)
